companies.name: ゼネラル・モーターズ

relations.text: 旧親会社。GM系ディーラーと顧客が今も顧客の大きな部分を占める
relations.text_en: Former parent; GM dealers and their customers remain a large share of its business

source.label: Ally Financial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: GM and Stellantis dealers and their retail customers continue to constitute a significant portion of our customer base, which creates concentration risk for us.

relations.text: 海外事業をGM Financialに売却する契約(2012年)
relations.text_en: Agreed to sell international operations to GM Financial (2012)

source.label: GM Financial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Purchase and Sale Agreement, dated as of November 21, 2012, by and among Ally Financial Inc., General Motors Financial Company, Inc. and General Motors Company

relations.text: 米国のStellantisディーラーの約25%に在庫金融を提供
relations.text_en: Provides floorplan funding to about 25% of Stellantis US dealers

source.label: Stellantis 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: with Bank of America and Ally Financial Inc. complementing wholesale funding offer to, approximately an additional 8 percent and 25 percent respectively

relations.text: Carvanaの自動車ローン債権を買い取る基本契約(2016年から)
relations.text_en: Buys Carvana's auto loans under a master purchase agreement since 2016

source.label: Carvana 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2016, the Company entered into a master purchase and sale agreement (the "Ally MPSA") with Ally Bank and Ally Financial Inc.

relations.text: 全国展開の中古車販売店としてCarMaxを主要顧客に挙げる
relations.text_en: Names CarMax among its national used-vehicle retailer clients

source.label: Ally Financial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: such as CarMax and EchoPark, as well as primarily online automotive retailers, such as Carvana.

companies.name: ソニック・オートモーティブ

relations.text: 傘下EchoParkを全国展開の中古車販売の顧客に挙げる
relations.text_en: Names its EchoPark brand among national used-vehicle retailer clients

source.label: Ally Financial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary customers are automotive dealers, which include OEM-franchised dealers, non-OEM-franchised dealers with a national presence, and automotive retailers, such as Carvana, CarMax, and EchoPark.

companies.name: シンクロニー・フィナンシャル

relations.text: Synchronyが10-Kで、預金の競合(ネット銀行)の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Synchrony lists Ally first among direct bank deposit competitors

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: such as Ally Financial, American Express, Barclays, Capital One, CIT, Citi, E-Trade and Marcus by Goldman Sachs.
